rationale: The genuine decision differs from the planted copy only in its interval, which now correctly runs from 1916-11-21 (date of EO 2489 in the held ProQuest text) to 1940-03-13 (signing of EO 8376). Both cited EO 8376 spans (5 FR 1077 OCR and APP mirror) match their hashes and offsets: paragraph 2 revokes EO 2489 by number, and paragraph 1 returns its sole tract (NE1/4 sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W.) to Interior control with no savings clause. The full-corpus number sweep finds only those two citations, so no earlier end appears, and the end is a primary revocation rather than an editorial note. I could not independently verify the producer's statement that the EO 2489 scan page was inspected; that does not affect the NO, which rests on the FR text of EO 8376.
